task.description: 比较苹果和微软 2025 财年的营收、净利润和经营现金流，做成表格并附原始财报出处。
task.inputs: Apple Inc. / AAPL 与 Microsoft / MSFT；各公司自身的 2025 财年全年合并报表；使用截至 2026-09-09 已公开的 GAAP 报告。注明各自财年结束日期，金额统一为十亿美元。
task.expected_output: 两家公司、三个指标的比较表；财年结束日期、币种和单位；可定位原始年报或监管披露的出处。
task.success: 六个指标与事前保存的各公司 2025 年报匹配，允许显示单位带来的舍入；不混用自然年、单季度、TTM 或调整后利润；财年结束日期和单位正确；原始披露能支持所列指标；核心数据来自指定服务。
task.failure: 缺指标或来源；把净利润与每股收益混淆；期间、公司、口径或单位错误；引用无法支持数值；只给摘要不提供比较表；预算内未完成。环境故障单列无效。
task.resources: 本轮指定服务及其公开文档；可读取该服务返回链接所指向的公司/监管原始披露，用于追溯出处，不能直接绕过被测服务完成取数。只读、仅免费额度。

environment.isolation: Dedicated Docker container; uid 1000 executor; fresh home/session/workspace; controller-only raw model capture; retained service-tools
environment.preparation_note: Reuses independently passed access from this batch with fresh session and cleaned workspace. Same frozen v1 task, model, effort, tools and 25-request budget for both services. Reference values and peer results withheld from executors. Registered secrets are removed from independent grading copies and peer snapshots; original raw evidence remains controller-private. Execution 600s; independent grading 300s.

reason: Executor queried the designated service SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov) XBRL APIs for both companies' FY2025 10-K and produced the required comparison table with fiscal-year ends, USD billions and traceable 10-K provenance. Grader re-read the collected raw SEC responses and re-fetched Apple NetIncomeLoss live; all six metrics, both fiscal-year ends, units and sources match the independent reference.

applicability.rule: SEC EDGAR data APIs state they 'do not require any authentication or API keys to access'; SEC data is publicly available at no charge and this task was scoped to read-only free usage.
applicability.observed: All data retrieval used only the free data.sec.gov companyconcept and submissions endpoints with a descriptive User-Agent; no API key, registration, payment or paid endpoint was involved, and every request returned HTTP 200.
applicability.evidence: grading/artifacts/evidence/sec-edgar-fy2025-values.md; execution/artifacts/raw/ (the collected HTTP 200 SEC responses) reproduce the data obtained without any key or payment.

service_cost.note: SEC EDGAR is a free public government disclosure service; no per-query charge applies and no account/receipt exists. service_cost_usd left null because there is no billed amount to report.

checks.criterion: Output is a comparison table covering both companies and all three metrics (revenue, net income, operating cash flow), with currency and unit stated
checks.evidence: execution/artifacts/result.md and execution/answer.md present a 2-company x 3-metric table labelled USD billions, with a caption on fiscal-year-end differences.

checks.criterion: All six indicator values match the independent reference (Apple 416.161 / 112.010 / 111.482; Microsoft 281.724 / 101.832 / 136.162, USD billions)
checks.evidence: grading/artifacts/evidence/sec-edgar-fy2025-values.md plus the six raw SEC companyconcept responses under execution/artifacts/raw/ reproduce the exact USD values (416,161,000,000; 112,010,000,000; 111,482,000,000; 281,724,000,000; 101,832,000,000; 136,162,000,000) and match reference.json.

checks.criterion: Fiscal-year end dates are correct (Apple 2025-09-27, Microsoft 2025-06-30)
checks.evidence: SEC submissions metadata in execution/artifacts/raw/aapl_submissions.json and msft_submissions.json show Apple 10-K report period 2025-09-27 and Microsoft 10-K report period 2025-06-30; the XBRL annual periods are 2024-09-29..2025-09-27 and 2024-07-01..2025-06-30.

checks.criterion: Amounts carried in a consistent unit (USD billions) as required, without unit confusion
checks.evidence: execution/artifacts/result.md and execution/answer.md state USD billions and the displayed values are the USD-million originals divided consistently by 1e9 (416161 -> 416.161 etc.).

checks.criterion: Original disclosure that supports the figures is locatable (form, accession number, report/regulator URL)
checks.evidence: execution/artifacts/result.md lists Apple 10-K accession 0000320193-25-000079 (filed 2025-10-31) and Microsoft 10-K accession 0000950170-25-100235 (filed 2025-07-30) with SEC Archives URLs; accessions match the raw XBRL accn fields and SEC submissions.

checks.criterion: No mixing of calendar year, single quarter, TTM or adjusted figures; annual consolidated GAAP FY2025 values
checks.evidence: Only 10-K full-year durations (363-364 days) were selected per metric in the raw responses; a FY2025 live re-fetch of Apple NetIncomeLoss returned the same 2024-09-29..2025-09-27 value.

checks.criterion: Core data were obtained from the designated service (data.sec.gov), not bypassed with another source or model memory
checks.evidence: Execution tool logs (review-packet/tools/0007.json, 0009.json) show curl calls to data.sec.gov companyconcept and submissions endpoints returning HTTP 200; URL scan of events.jsonl shows only data.sec.gov used for data retrieval.

checks.criterion: Operated within the read-only, free scope: no registration, payment, writes or paid endpoints
checks.evidence: Only SEC free XBRL/submissions endpoints were called with a descriptive User-Agent; no API key or payment was used and no paid endpoint appears in the logs.
